channel.title: Hippo updates
channel.description: Stable and opt-in beta updates for Hippo.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.0
item.description:
# Hippo 1.0.0
First public release with built-in updates.
- Check for updates from the Hippo menu or Settings → Updates. - Automatic update checks, with installation kept out of active recordings. - Optional beta updates for testing upcoming releases before Stable. - Sidebar icons and selection highlights follow your chosen accent, with readable selected text. - A wider, top-aligned meeting timeline with pinned speaker names and scrolling. - A more prominent “Check again” button in the live meeting’s People tab. - DeepSeek removed from meeting summary and fallback choices; Ollama remains available for local models. Existing DeepSeek summary selections move to Apple on-device.
Requires Apple silicon and macOS 26 or later. Developer ID signed and Apple notarized.
Existing users: install this release manually once to enable future in-app updates.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.1
item.description:
Improves Today’s Brief and meeting review workflows. Brief suggestions now have a separate persistent checklist; Action Items and Timeline views have clearer controls and accessibility descriptions; the Home and Known Voices views are easier to scan.
Requires macOS 26 or later. Apple silicon.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.1
item.description:
Action Items now adapts its controls to the available window width. Wider views use a compact header; narrower views keep the title and controls readable and provide all scopes in a menu.
Requires macOS 26 or later. Apple silicon.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.1
item.description:
Fixes Action Items checkboxes so clicking anywhere inside the square toggles completion, including the empty center of an unchecked box.
Requires macOS 26 or later on Apple silicon.
